title: 皐月賞の後に・すべてのウマ娘の憧れ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky's performance at the Satsuki Sho is absolute perfection, and she declares herself a worthy athlete to chase after.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week and Grass Wonder, who saw Maruzensky run, both vow to catch up to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smiling in response, Maruzensky says that she'll do her best to live up to their expectations in the Japanese Derby.
